_comment: Solstice M0 card data - earth branch. Contract: shared/schema/card.schema.json. Names come from docs/CARDS.md SS3.1 (M0 first ten candidates) plus provisional M0 grid slots.
_note: provisional=true means: this slot is written for playability so the M0 grid is complete, while its effect / params / animation / visible feedback have NOT yet been authored per card (CARD-LIST SS3 definition). Authoring order follows P1-P4 need.

desc.zh: 拈起的一撮土，落在纸上就成了一小片地。零环碎片：放下即散尽，不留回响。
desc.en: A pinch of earth. Dropped on the paper it becomes a small patch of ground. A tier-0 shard: it is spent on release and leaves no echo.

desc.zh: 把一层细土从指缝里筛下去，薄薄地铺满一小块。
desc.en: Sift a layer of fine soil through your fingers to dust a small area.

desc.zh: 一小片地面记住自己该是平的。
desc.en: A small patch of ground remembers it should be flat.

desc.zh: 半径三米的土丘，峰高两米。永久。
desc.en: A mound three metres across, two metres at its crown. Permanent.

desc.zh: 笔刷扫过的地面整体抬高，纸层被顶起来。
desc.en: The brushed ground is pushed up as a whole, lifting the paper layers.

desc.zh: 一片地面从此不再塌、不再滑，坡度被写死。
desc.en: A patch of ground will no longer slump or slide; its slope is written down.

desc.zh: 半径八米、峰高六米的丘陵。一层纸叠成一座小丘。
desc.en: A hill eight metres across and six metres high: one sheet folded into a rise.

desc.zh: 指腹按下去，纸面凹出一个浅坑。
desc.en: Press with a fingertip and the paper gives way into a shallow hollow.

desc.zh: 这一片只许以纸板的方式存在：高的地方刮平，低的地方垫平。
desc.en: This ground may only exist as stacked boards: high places are scraped flat, low places filled.

desc.zh: 沿笔刷方向隆起一道山脊，把界切成两半。
desc.en: A ridge rises along the brush and cuts the realm in two.

desc.zh: 从一处下切，撕开一道深缝，纸的断面露出来。
desc.en: Cut down from one point and tear open a deep seam; the paper's cross-section shows.

desc.zh: 整个界按层叠的方式重新排布：高处被削，低处被填，直到每层都咬得严丝合缝。
desc.en: The whole realm is re-stacked: peaks shaved, hollows filled, until every layer sits flush.
